item.title: “CM Abdullah assures Early ULB, Panchayat Polls; Flags Vacancy in State Election Commissioner Post”
item.description: Jammu, Feb 9: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Monday said that the government is making necessary arrangements to hold elections to urban local bodies and panchayats in the Union territory at the earliest, but said the post of state election commissioner is presently vacant. item.title: “J&K Unemployment higher than National Average: Dy. CM Surinder Choudhary”
item.description: Jammu, Feb 9: The unemployment rate in Jammu and Kashmir has remained consistently higher than the national average over the past several years, Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary said on Monday, citing official data from the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS). item.title: Hindus in Bangladesh have chosen to unite and resist, says Bhagwat
item.description: Mumbai: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat on Sunday said the Hindu population in Bangladesh has chosen to unite and resist rather than flee, and assured them of the Sangh’s support. Addressing an interactive session organised to mark the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh’s (RSS) centenary, Bhagwat spoke on a wide range of issues, including his retirement, language, caste, population imbalance, the Uniform Civil Code (UCC), infiltration, religion, and national unity. item.title: Centre fast-tracks Sawalkot Hydel Power Project with IWT in abeyance
item.description: Jammu: The Union government has accelerated work on a major hydroelectric project on the Chenab river in Jammu and Kashmir, with state-run NHPC floating a ₹5,129 crore tender for the long-pending Sawalkot Hydroelectric Project in Ramban district. item.title: Mega revamp for Vaishno Devi: Museum, light show, Rs 10 Lakh insurance for pilgrims approved
item.description: Jammu: The Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine Board (SMVDSB) on Sunday approved a series of high-impact measures to transform the Mata Vaishno Devi shrine and its surrounding region into a world-class spiritual destination. item.title: Man Detained in Jammu Kashmir for Allegedly Disrespecting National Flag
item.description: Srinagar,Feb 10: Doda Police have registered an FIR and detained a person after a video allegedly showing the disrespect of the Indian National Flag surfaced on social media. The incident came to light after a clip went viral in which a man, identified as Farooq Ahmed, son of Mohammad Ramzan Banday and a resident of Nagri, Doda, was purportedly seen using the national flag to clean the window glass of his house. item.description: Srinagar,Feb 10: An unidentified man sustained critical injuries after being struck by a car in the Chanapora area of Srinagar, officials said. Officials said the accident involved a Swift Dzire vehicle bearing registration number JK01AU-0385. The vehicle was reportedly, driven by a man from Zewan, Srinagar. item.title: No role of cabinet in Vaishno Devi ropeway project: CM Omar Abdullah
item.description: Jammu, Feb 10: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Tuesday clarified in the Legislative Assembly that the Council of Ministers had no role in approving the ropeway project for the Shri Mata Vaishno Devi shrine. He said that after examining official records, it was found that neither the cabinet nor the Administrative Council had cleared the project. According to the Chief Minister, the approval was granted by the Lieutenant Governor in September 2024, prior to the formation of the elected government
